    font-weight: 500;
    gap: 10px;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    user-select: none;
}

/* Nav dropdown */
.dropdown {
    position: relative;
}
.dropdown > .dropdown-menu,
.dropdown > .dropdown-menu-end {
    display: none;
    background: var(--bs-body-bg);
    position: absolute;
    top: 100%;
    border-radius: var(--bs-border-radius);
    overflow: hidden;
    z-index: 2147483647;
}
.dropdown > .dropdown-menu-end {
    right: 0;
}
.dropdown > .dropdown-menu > .dropdown-item {
    color: var(--bs-body-color);
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
    border: none;
    background: none;
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.dropdown > .dropdown-menu > .dropdown-item:hover {
    background: var(--bs-secondary-bg);
    color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
}
.dropdown > .dropdown-menu > .dropdown-item.active {
    background: var(--bs-secondary-bg);
    color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
}

#main {
    position: absolute;
    top: var(--global-nav-height);
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
}
.page-wrapper {
    /* background-color: var(--bg-color); */
    /* color: var(--text-default); */
    background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
    color: var(--bs-body-color);
    position: relative;
    height: 100%;
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-flow: row nowrap;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.navigation {
    /* background-color: var(--nav-bg-color); */
    background-color: var(--bs-nav-bg);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 #0000;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: var(--side-nav-width);
    height: 100%;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    overflow-y: auto;
    position: relative;
    border-top: .5px solid var(--bs-border-color);
    border-right: .5px solid var(--bs-border-color);
    transition: width .15s cubic-bezier(0,.57,.21,.99), box-shadow .15s cubic-bezier(0,.57,.21,.99);
    z-index: 101;
}
.navigation-body {
    flex-grow: 1;
}
.navigation-body, .navigation-footer {
    /* background-color: var(--nav-bg-color); */
    background-color: var(--bs-nav-bg);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 #0000;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 12px 12px 6px;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    overflow-y: auto;
    position: relative;
    transition: width .15s cubic-bezier(0,.57,.21,.99), box-shadow .15s cubic-bezier(0,.57,.21,.99);
    z-index: 101;
}
.navigation-footer {
    /* background-color: var(--deep-bg-color); */
    background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.navigation .subheading {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    height: 16px;
    line-height: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    margin-top: 10px;
    padding: 0 12px;
    /* color: var(--gray-900); */
    color: var(--bs-body-color);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.navigation .item {
    /* color: var(--text-secondary); */
    color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
    align-items: baseline;
    border-radius: 8px;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 1px;
    padding: 6px 12px;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background-color .1s ease-in-out;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
}
.navigation .item:hover,
.navigation .item.active {
    background-color: var(--gray-100);
    color: var(--text-default);
    /* background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
    color: var(--bs-body-color); */
}
.item .item-label {
    margin-left: 8px;
}
/* Inner item */
.item.subgroup {
    margin-left: 12px;
}

/* Mobile nav */
.navigation {
    margin-left: calc(-1 * var(--side-nav-width));
    transition: margin-left .15s cubic-bezier(0,.57,.21,.99);
}
.navigation.active { margin-left: 0 }
.mobile { display: block !important }
.desktop { display: none !important }
.global-nav { padding: 0 }
@media (min-width: 576px) {
    .global-nav { padding: 0 24px }
    .navigation { margin-left: 0 }
    .mobile { display: none !important }
    .desktop { display: block !important }
    .global-nav-item.logo { padding: 0; margin: 0; }
}

    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 2em;
    padding: 0 0.5em;
    color: #8e8ea0;
    /* border-right: 1px solid #353740; */
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 20px;
    overflow: hidden;
    z-index: 1;
    background: #000;
}
.code-block {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding-left: calc(3em + 1px);
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: auto;
    padding-right: 2em;
    white-space: pre;
}
.line-numbers,
.code-block {
    padding-top: 0.5em;
    padding-bottom: 1em;
}
.line {
    height: 20px;
    line-height: 20px;
}

</style><script type="text/javascript">function init_toast() {
    // Toast setup for notifications
    const $toast = document.createElement('div')
    $toast.style.position = 'fixed'
    $toast.style.top = '20px'
    $toast.style.left = '50%'
    $toast.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)'
    $toast.style.backgroundColor = '#333'
    $toast.style.color = 'white'
    $toast.style.padding = '10px 20px'
    $toast.style.borderRadius = '5px'
    $toast.style.boxShadow = '0 2px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)'
    $toast.style.display = 'none'
    $toast.style.zIndex = '10000'
    $toast.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s'
    document.documentElement.appendChild($toast)

    let toast_timeout
    globalThis.show_toast = message => {
        if (toast_timeout) clearTimeout(toast_timeout)
        console.log(message)
        $toast.textContent = message
        $toast.style.display = 'block'
        $toast.style.opacity = '1'
        toast_timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            $toast.style.opacity = '0'
            setTimeout(() => $toast.style.display = 'none', 500)
        }, 3000)
    }
}

function init_mobile_nav_toggle() {
    // Navigation toggle for mobile
    const $side_nav = document.querySelector('.navigation')
    const $expand = document.querySelector('.expand-nav')
    $expand.addEventListener('click', () => $side_nav.classList.toggle('active'))

    // Close the navigation when clicking outside
    document.addEventListener('click', e => {
        if (!e.target.closest('.global-nav-item')) {
            document.querySelector('.navigation').classList.remove('active')
        }
    })
}

function init_group_selection() {
    function normalize_id(group) {
        if (!group) {
            return ''
        }
        return group.startsWith('#') ? group.slice(1) : group
    }

    function select_group(group, options = {}) {
        const { scroll = true, behavior = 'auto' } = options
        const id = normalize_id(group)
        if (!id) {
            return
        }
        const hash = `#${id}`

        const $nav = document.querySelector(`.navigation .group-link[href="${hash}"]`)
        if ($nav) {
            document.querySelectorAll(`.group-link[href="${hash}"]:not(.active)`).forEach($e => $e.classList.add('active'))
            document.querySelectorAll(`.group-link:not([href="${hash}"]).active`).forEach($e => $e.classList.remove('active'))

            const expands = $nav.dataset?.expands
            if (expands) {
                document.querySelectorAll(`.group-link.group-root[data-expands="${expands}"]:not(.active)`).forEach($e => $e.classList.add('active'))
                document.querySelectorAll(`.group-link:not([data-expands="${expands}"]):not(.hidden):not(.group-root)`).forEach($e => $e.classList.add('hidden'))
                document.querySelectorAll(`.group-link.hidden[data-expands="${expands}"]`).forEach($e => $e.classList.remove('hidden'))
            }

            $nav.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' })
        }

        if (scroll) {
            const $section = document.getElementById(`${id}-section`)
            if ($section) {
                $section.scrollIntoView({ behavior, block: 'start' })
            }
        }
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.group-link').forEach($e => $e.addEventListener('click', event => {
        event.preventDefault()
        const href = $e.getAttribute('href')
        if (!href) {
            return
        }
        select_group(href, { behavior: 'smooth' })
        if (window.location.hash !== href) {
            history.pushState(null, '', href)
        }
    }))

    const initialHash = new URL(window.location.href).hash || document.querySelector('.group-link')?.getAttribute('href')
    select_group(initialHash, { scroll: !!window.location.hash })
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => select_group(window.location.hash, { behavior: 'smooth' }))

    let timeout_id = null
    const $page = document.querySelector('.page')
    $page.addEventListener('wheel', () => {
        if (timeout_id) {
            clearTimeout(timeout_id)
        }
        timeout_id = setTimeout(() => {
            for (const $group of document.querySelectorAll('section.operation')) {
                const rect = $group.getBoundingClientRect()
                if (rect.top < 200 && rect.bottom > 200) {
                    select_group($group.id.replace('-section', ''), { scroll: false })
                    break
                }
            }
        }, 15)
    })
}

function init_prop_expansion() {
    // Property object collapse/expand functionality
    const $buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.param-expand-button')
    $buttons.forEach($e => {
        const $properties = $e.nextElementSibling
        $e.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const expanded = $e.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true'
            $e.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !expanded)
            $properties.classList.toggle('hidden', expanded)
        })
    })

    //- // Expand all properties if the URL has ?expand=all
    //- if (window.location.search.includes('expand=all')) {
    //-     $buttons.forEach($e => {
    //-         $e.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true')
    //-         $e.nextElementSibling.classList.remove('hidden')
    //-     })
    //- }

    // Expand all properties by default
    $buttons.forEach($e => {
        $e.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true')
        $e.nextElementSibling.classList.remove('hidden')
    })
}

function init_notice_toast() {
    //- localStorage.removeItem('notice-dismissed')  // Test remove
    function dismiss_notice() {
        document.querySelector('.notice').classList.add('hidden')
        localStorage.setItem('notice-dismissed', 'true')
    }

    if (localStorage.getItem('notice-dismissed')) {
        return
    }
    document.querySelector('.notice').classList.remove('hidden')
    document.querySelector('.notice-dismiss').addEventListener('click', dismiss_notice)
}

function init_code_samples() {
    function select_lang(lower_label) {
        lower_label = lower_label.toLowerCase()
        for (const $parent of document.querySelectorAll('div.code-sample')) {
            // Find the correct language
            const $option = $parent.querySelector(`select.code-sample-select option[data-label="${lower_label}"]`)
            if (!$option) {
                continue
            }

            const label = $option.textContent
            const lang = $option.value

            // Select option
            const $select = $parent.querySelector('select.code-sample-select')
            $select.value = lang
            $parent.querySelector('div.code-sample-select-val').textContent = label  // Display the selected language
            $select.querySelectorAll('option').forEach($option => $option.removeAttribute('selected'))
            $option.setAttribute('selected', 'selected')

            // Show the correct code sample
            $parent.querySelectorAll('.code-sample-body pre').forEach($pre => $pre.classList.add('hidden'))
            $parent.querySelector(`.code-sample-body pre.hljs.${lang}`).classList.remove('hidden')
        }

        // Add query params to the URL
        const url = new URL(window.location.href)
        url.searchParams.set('lang', lower_label)
        history.pushState({}, '', url)
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('select.code-sample-select').forEach($select => {
        $select.addEventListener('change', () => {
            const lang = $select.value
            const label = $select.querySelector(`option[value="${lang}"]`).textContent
            if (!label) {
                return console.warn(`missing option label ${label} for ${$select.dataset.id}`)
            }
            select_lang(label)
        })
    })

    // Select the correct language based on the query params
    const url = new URL(window.location.href)
    const label = url.searchParams.get('lang')
    if (label) {
        select_lang(label)
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.code-sample-copy').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const $parent = btn.closest('.code-sample')
            const $pres = $parent.querySelectorAll('.code-sample-body pre:not(.hidden) .code-block > .line')

            // Get the code lines
            const lines = []
            $pres.forEach($pre => lines.push($pre.textContent))

            // Copy the code to the clipboard
            const content = lines.join('\n')
            console.log(content)
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(content)
                .then(() => show_toast('Code copied to clipboard'))
                .catch(() => show_toast('Failed to copy code to clipboard'))
        })
    })
}

function init_feedback() {
    // TODO: Implement feedback
    document.querySelectorAll('.docs-feedback-btn').forEach($e => $e.addEventListener('click', () => show_toast('Thanks! Your feedback helps improve our documentation.')))
}

function init_dropdown() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown').forEach($dropdown => {
        const $menu = $dropdown.querySelector('.dropdown-menu')
        $dropdown.addEventListener('click', () => {
            $menu.style.display = $menu.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block'
        })
    })
    document.addEventListener('click', e => {
        if (!e.target.closest('.dropdown')) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-menu').forEach($menu => $menu.style.display = 'none')
        }
    })
}

function main() {
    init_toast()
    init_mobile_nav_toggle()
    init_group_selection()
    init_prop_expansion()
    init_notice_toast()
    init_code_samples()
    init_feedback()
    init_dropdown()
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', main)

    'use strict'
    const get_theme_store = () => localStorage.getItem('theme')
    const set_theme_store = theme => localStorage.setItem('theme', theme)
    const get_theme_pref = () => {
        const theme = get_theme_store()
        if (theme) {
            return theme
        }
        return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light'
    }
    const set_theme = theme => {
        if (theme === 'auto') {
            document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bs-theme', (window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light'))
        } else {
            document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bs-theme', theme)
        }
    }
    set_theme(get_theme_pref())
    const show_theme_active = (theme, focus = false) => {
        const $switch = document.querySelector('#bd-theme')
        if (!$switch) {
            return
        }
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-theme-value]').forEach(element => {
            element.classList.remove('active')
            element.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false')
        })
        const $btn = document.querySelector(`[data-bs-theme-value="${theme}"]`)
        $btn.classList.add('active')
        $btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true')
        document.querySelector('.theme-icon-active use').setAttribute('href', $btn.querySelector('svg use').getAttribute('href'))
        //- $switch.setAttribute('aria-label', `${document.querySelector('#bd-theme-text').textContent} (${$btn.dataset.bsThemeValue})`)
        if (focus) {
            $switch.focus()
        }
    }
    window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').addEventListener('change', () => {
        if (['light', 'dark'].includes(get_theme_store())) {
            set_theme(get_theme_pref())
        }
    })
    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        show_theme_active(get_theme_pref())
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-theme-value]').forEach(toggle => {
            toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const theme = toggle.getAttribute('data-bs-theme-value')
                set_theme_store(theme)
                set_theme(theme)
                show_theme_active(theme, true)
            })
        })
    })
})()
